Full Stack Developer.title: Full Stack Developer
Full Stack Developer.description: Designs and develops both client-facing frontend applications and scalable backend web services.

JavaScript.title: JavaScript Fundamentals & ES6+
JavaScript.description: Master core JS concepts: closures, promises, event loop, async/await, DOM manipulation, and modern ES6+ syntax.
JavaScript.milestone_project: Build an interactive CRUD Task Dashboard using vanilla JS and Fetch API.

React.title: React.js Component Architecture & State Management
React.description: Learn functional components, Hooks (useState, useEffect, useContext), custom hooks, routing, and component lifecycles.
React.milestone_project: Build a responsive E-commerce Product Catalog with filtering, cart, and checkout flow.

Node.js.title: Node.js & Backend Architecture
Node.js.description: Understand asynchronous event-driven I/O, Node core modules, file system, streams, and npm ecosystem.
Node.js.milestone_project: Create a command-line automated CLI utility and a background file-processing script.

Express.js.title: Express.js REST API Development
Express.js.description: Design modular routing, custom middleware, error handling, JWT authentication, and request validation.
Express.js.milestone_project: Develop a secure REST API with JWT Auth, rate limiting, and input sanitization.

MongoDB.title: MongoDB & NoSQL Database Modeling
MongoDB.description: Master document schemas, Mongoose ODM, aggregation pipelines, indexing, and data validation.
MongoDB.milestone_project: Design a relational-like schema with subdocuments and write aggregations for analytics.

REST API.title: RESTful API Standards & API Architecture
REST API.description: Learn HTTP status codes, API versioning, CORS handling, OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, and Postman testing.
REST API.milestone_project: Document and publish a full Swagger/OpenAPI spec for your backend endpoints.

Git.title: Git & GitHub Version Control
Git.description: Master branch management, pull requests, resolving merge conflicts, and standard commit workflows.
Git.milestone_project: Contribute to an open-source repository following PR guidelines and Gitflow.

HTML.title: Semantic HTML5 & Accessibility
HTML.description: Learn semantic elements, accessibility (WCAG/ARIA), meta tags, and structured SEO markup.
HTML.milestone_project: Create an accessible landing page conforming to WCAG AA standards.

CSS.title: Modern CSS3, Flexbox & Grid
CSS.description: Master responsive layouts using Flexbox, CSS Grid, media queries, CSS variables, and modern styling utilities.
CSS.milestone_project: Design a complex responsive multi-column dashboard with dark/light themes.

Docker.title: Containerization with Docker
Docker.description: Containerize full stack applications with Dockerfile, multi-stage builds, and Docker Compose.
Docker.milestone_project: Containerize frontend, backend, and MongoDB database with one docker-compose.yml.

Python Developer.title: Python Developer
Python Developer.description: Specializes in building robust backend services, APIs, data pipelines, and automation tools using Python.

Python.title: Advanced Python & Idiomatic Coding
Python.description: Master generators, decorators, context managers, list comprehensions, and typing in Python.
Python.milestone_project: Build an asynchronous log analysis parser using Python generators and multiprocessing.

OOP.title: Object-Oriented Programming & Design Patterns
OOP.description: Master SOLID principles, encapsulation, polymorphism, inheritance, and patterns (Factory, Singleton, Observer).
OOP.milestone_project: Build an extensible payment gateway simulator using OOP design patterns.

Flask.title: Flask Microframework Architecture
Flask.description: Build lightweight microservices, application factories, blueprints, and database integrations with SQLAlchemy.
Flask.milestone_project: Create a multi-tenant REST API with Blueprints, JWT tokens, and rate-limiting.

Django.title: Django & Django REST Framework (DRF)
Django.description: Master Django ORM, migrations, serializers, generic views, authentication, and the built-in admin dashboard.
Django.milestone_project: Develop a role-based SaaS platform backend with Django REST Framework.

SQL.title: Relational Databases & SQL Optimization
SQL.description: Write complex multi-table joins, subqueries, indexing, window functions, and schema normalization.
SQL.milestone_project: Analyze an e-commerce transactional database with indexed queries and performance benchmarks.

REST API.title: API Design & Serialization
REST API.description: Implement standard RESTful endpoints, error formatting, swagger documentation, and automated tests with PyTest.
REST API.milestone_project: Build an API test suite with Pytest, mock fixtures, and coverage reports.

Git.title: Git Branching & Collaborative Workflows
Git.description: Learn semantic versioning, rebasing, squashing commits, and GitHub Actions CI pipelines.
Git.milestone_project: Set up a GitHub Actions workflow that runs PyTest on every pull request.

Data Analyst.title: Data Analyst
Data Analyst.description: Transforms raw structured and unstructured data into meaningful insights, reports, and interactive dashboards.

SQL.title: Advanced SQL for Analytics
SQL.description: Master window functions (RANK, DENSE_RANK, LEAD, LAG), CTEs, complex grouping, and query profiling.
SQL.milestone_project: Write SQL queries to compute Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) and user retention cohorts.

Excel.title: Advanced Excel, PivotTables & XLOOKUP
Excel.description: Learn advanced financial functions, conditional formatting, dynamic arrays, Power Query, and what-if analysis.
Excel.milestone_project: Build an executive financial budget tracker with dynamic pivot charts and automated lookups.

Python.title: Python for Data Analysis
Python.description: Learn Python data structures, list/dict comprehensions, data wrangling, and working with CSV/JSON/API data.

resources.name: Automate the Boring Stuff with Python

Python.milestone_project: Scrape web data and process it into structured CSV files for analysis.

Pandas.title: Data Manipulation with Pandas
Pandas.description: Master DataFrames, Series, handling missing data, groupby aggregations, merging, and reshaping data.
Pandas.milestone_project: Clean and preprocess a messy 100,000-row customer dataset with anomaly removal.

NumPy.title: Numerical Computing with NumPy
NumPy.description: Learn multidimensional arrays, vectorization, mathematical operations, slicing, and linear algebra fundamentals.
NumPy.milestone_project: Implement vectorized mathematical simulations comparing speed against native Python loops.

Statistics.title: Applied Business Statistics & A/B Testing
Statistics.description: Learn probability distributions, hypothesis testing (t-test, chi-square), confidence intervals, and correlation analysis.
Statistics.milestone_project: Design and interpret a randomized A/B test experiment with p-value calculation.

Power BI.title: Interactive Dashboards in Power BI
Power BI.description: Connect diverse data sources, build DAX calculations, configure relationships, and build executive dashboards.
Power BI.milestone_project: Develop an interactive 3-page Sales Performance & KPI Dashboard with drill-through filters.

Data Visualization.title: Visual Data Storytelling (Seaborn & Matplotlib)
Data Visualization.description: Select the right chart type, format color palettes, eliminate visual clutter, and build informative graphics.
Data Visualization.milestone_project: Generate an explanatory visualization report explaining customer churn drivers.

AI/ML Engineer.title: AI/ML Engineer
AI/ML Engineer.description: Designs, trains, evaluates, and deploys machine learning and deep learning models into production environments.

Python.title: Python for Scientific Computing
Python.description: Master vectorized computing, array indexing, performance profiling, and object-oriented ML pipelines.
Python.milestone_project: Write modular data loader pipelines and custom metric evaluation functions.

NumPy.title: Linear Algebra & NumPy Arrays
NumPy.description: Matrix multiplication, eigenvalues, dot products, broadcasting, and matrix decompositions.
NumPy.milestone_project: Implement linear regression and neural network forward pass from scratch using pure NumPy.

Pandas.title: Feature Engineering & Data Preprocessing
Pandas.description: Handling missing features, one-hot encoding, target encoding, outlier detection, and scaling.
Pandas.milestone_project: Build an automated end-to-end feature pipeline using Scikit-learn ColumnTransformer.

Statistics.title: Probability & Inferential Statistics for ML
Statistics.description: Bayes theorem, maximum likelihood estimation (MLE), loss functions, bias-variance tradeoff.
Statistics.milestone_project: Analyze model confidence intervals and calibrate predicted probabilities.

Machine Learning.title: Supervised & Unsupervised Machine Learning
Machine Learning.description: Regression, Decision Trees, Random Forests, Gradient Boosting (XGBoost/LightGBM), K-Means, and PCA.
Machine Learning.milestone_project: Train and optimize an ensemble classifier achieving >85% F1-score with hyperparameter tuning.

Scikit-learn.title: Production ML Pipelines with Scikit-learn
Scikit-learn.description: Pipelines, GridSearchCV, cross-validation, custom transformers, model evaluation curves (ROC, PR curve).
Scikit-learn.milestone_project: Deploy a serialized joblib pipeline into a lightweight inference web service.

Deep Learning.title: Neural Networks & Backpropagation
Deep Learning.description: Multi-layer perceptrons, activation functions, optimizers (Adam, SGD), regularization (Dropout, BatchNorm).
Deep Learning.milestone_project: Build and train a custom neural network from first principles.

TensorFlow.title: TensorFlow & Keras Deep Learning Architectures
TensorFlow.description: Build Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for vision, Recurrent/Transformer models, and model checkpointing.
TensorFlow.milestone_project: Train a transfer learning model using MobileNet for real-time image classification.

Java Developer.title: Java Developer
Java Developer.description: Develops enterprise-grade, high-throughput, secure backend applications and microservices using Java and Spring Boot.

Java.title: Core Java (Java 17/21) & JVM Internals
Java.description: Master Collections framework, Generics, Lambdas, Streams API, Multithreading, and Memory Management.
Java.milestone_project: Build a concurrent multithreaded bank transaction simulation with thread safety.

OOP.title: Object-Oriented Design & Clean Architecture
OOP.description: SOLID principles, Abstract classes vs Interfaces, immutability, Factory, Builder, and Strategy patterns.
OOP.milestone_project: Refactor a monolithic codebase into decoupled interfaces following SOLID.

SQL.title: Relational Databases & Data Modeling
SQL.description: Schema design, primary/foreign keys, joins, transactional isolation levels (ACID), and indexing.
SQL.milestone_project: Design a 3NF normalized database schema for a university management system.

JDBC.title: Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) & Connection Pooling
JDBC.description: Connection lifecycles, PreparedStatement vs Statement, transaction commit/rollback, and HikariCP connection pools.
JDBC.milestone_project: Build a high-performance database access layer with connection pooling.

Spring Boot.title: Spring Boot & Spring Framework Ecosystem
Spring Boot.description: Dependency Injection, Inversion of Control, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate ORM, and Spring Configuration.
Spring Boot.milestone_project: Develop a microservice backend with Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA, and H2/PostgreSQL.

REST API.title: Enterprise REST APIs with Spring Web
REST API.description: Build `@RestController` endpoints, DTO pattern, validation with `@Valid`, and global `@ControllerAdvice` exception handling.
REST API.milestone_project: Build a secure REST API with OpenAPI/Swagger documentation and custom error payloads.

Git.title: Git for Enterprise Development
Git.description: Feature branch workflows, pull requests, resolving merge conflicts, and automated Maven CI builds.
Git.milestone_project: Create a GitHub repository with protected branches and GitHub Actions for Maven clean test.
